name: Flourless Chocolate Brownies with Black Beans
steps: Blend the beans, eggs, cocoa, sugar, butter, vanilla and baking powder until smooth.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Bake in a lined pan at 350°F for 22 to 25 minutes and cool before cutting.

name: Oatmeal Cranberry Cookies
steps: Cream the butter and sugar, beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the oats, oat flour, baking powder, cinnamon and cranberries.
Scoop and bake at 350°F for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate No-Bake Bars
steps: Warm the peanut butter and stir in oats, chia, vanilla and sweetener.
Press into a lined pan.
Melt the chocolate over the top and chill 1 hour.

name: Lemon Ricotta Cheesecake Cups
steps: Whip the ricotta, yogurt, lemon juice, vanilla and sweetener until smooth.
Spoon into cups and chill 2 hours.
Top with blueberries.

name: New York-Style Crustless Cheesecake
steps: Beat the cream cheese, yogurt, sugar, vanilla and lemon until smooth, then the eggs.
Pour into a greased pan set in a water bath.
Bake at 325°F for 45 to 50 minutes and chill overnight.

name: Berry Cobbler with Oat Topping
steps: Toss the berries with lemon and half the sugar in a baking dish.
Rub the oats, almond flour, butter, cinnamon and remaining sugar into a crumble.
Cover the berries and bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Peach Crisp with Pecans
steps: Slice the peaches into a dish.
Rub the oats, pecans, butter, cinnamon and sugar into a crumble and spread on top.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Baked Pears with Walnuts and Cinnamon
steps: Halve and core the pears.
Fill with walnuts, cinnamon and butter.
Bake at 375°F for 25 to 30 minutes and serve with yogurt.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Pudding
steps: Whisk everything until smooth.
Chill 30 minutes.

name: Vanilla Panna Cotta with Berry Compote
steps: Bloom the gelatin in a little milk.
Warm the milk, cream, vanilla and sweetener and stir in the gelatin.
Pour into cups and chill 4 hours.
Simmer the berries briefly and spoon over.

name: Coconut Macaroons without Added Sugar
steps: Mix everything.
Scoop twelve mounds onto a lined tray.
Bake at 325°F for 15 minutes.

name: Pumpkin Spice Muffins with Oat Flour
steps: Whisk the pumpkin, eggs, milk and sugar.
Fold in the oat flour, spice and baking powder, then the walnuts.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Almond Flour Banana Muffins
steps: Mash the bananas and beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the almond flour, baking powder, cinnamon and walnuts.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Apple Cinnamon Muffins with Oat Flour
steps: Mix the eggs and applesauce.
Fold in the oat flour, cinnamon, baking powder, diced apple and walnuts.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Chocolate Avocado Pudding Cups
steps: Blend until silky.
Chill 1 hour.

name: Frozen Banana Soft Serve
steps: Blend frozen banana slices with peanut butter and vanilla until creamy.

name: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt Bark
steps: Stir the vanilla and sweetener into the yogurt and spread on a lined tray.
Top with chopped strawberries and pistachios.
Freeze 3 hours and break into pieces.

name: Mixed Berry Chia Jam Parfait
steps: Mash and warm the berries and stir in the chia; chill into a jam.
Layer yogurt and jam in glasses.
Top with chopped almonds.

name: Sweet Potato Brownie Bites
steps: Mash the cooked sweet potato with almond butter, egg, cocoa, baking powder and vanilla.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Bake in a mini tin at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Baked Apple Chips
steps: Slice the apples very thin.
Dust with cinnamon and arrange on lined trays.
Bake at 225°F for 80 to 90 minutes, turning once.

name: Iced Coffee with Almond Milk and Cinnamon
steps: Stir the cooled coffee with almond milk, cinnamon and vanilla.
Serve over ice.

name: Cold Brew with Cream
steps: Pour the cold brew over ice.
Top with the cream and a little stevia.

name: Homemade Hot Cocoa with Almond Milk
steps: Warm the almond milk and whisk in the cocoa, sweetener, vanilla and cinnamon.

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie with Yogurt
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Peach Ginger Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Tropical Green Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice until smooth.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice until smooth.

name: Blueberry Spinach Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice until smooth.

name: Iced Tea Lemonade, Unsweetened
steps: Combine the chilled tea, lemon juice and water.
Add mint and a pinch of stevia and serve over ice.

name: Cucumber Lime Agua Fresca
steps: Blend the cucumber with lime juice, sweetener and a little water.
Strain, add the rest of the water and chill with mint.

name: Strawberry Mint Sparkling Cooler
steps: Muddle the strawberries with lime, mint and stevia.
Top with sparkling water over ice.

name: Golden Milk with Cinnamon and Black Pepper
steps: Warm the milk with the spices and whisk until frothy.

name: Protein Coffee Shake
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Almond Joy Protein Shake
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Mint Chocolate Chip Green Shake
steps: Blend everything with ice until smooth.

name: Kefir Berry Lassi
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Ginger Turmeric Wellness Tea
steps: Simmer the ginger and turmeric in the water for 8 minutes.
Strain and add lemon and pepper.

name: Spiced Apple Cider Warm Drink, Unsweetened
steps: Simmer the sliced apple, orange and spices in the water 15 minutes.
Strain and serve warm.

name: Cinnamon Dolce Latte with Almond Milk
steps: Warm the almond milk with cinnamon, vanilla and sweetener and froth.
Pour over the coffee.

name: Vegan Chili with Three Beans
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the spices, tomatoes, beans and broth.
Simmer 30 minutes.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie with Mashed Potato Crust
steps: Simmer the lentils with the carrot, onion, paste, broth and thyme until tender; add peas.
Mash the potatoes with milk and butter.
Top the lentils with the mash and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchiladas
steps: Mix the beans, mashed sweet potato and onion.
Fill the tortillas, roll and pack in a dish.
Cover with sauce and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Eggplant and Chickpea Curry
steps: Brown the cubed eggplant in oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the curry powder.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk and eggplant and simmer 20 minutes.

name: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Burrito Bowl
steps: Crumble the tofu and sauté with the pepper, turmeric and cumin in oil.
Warm the beans and rice.
Build bowls and top with salsa and avocado.

name: Peanut Tofu Stir-Fry with Broccoli
steps: Brown the cubed tofu in oil.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger.
Whisk the peanut butter with soy sauce, vinegar and pepper flakes and toss everything together.

name: Chickpea Salad Sandwich Filling in Lettuce Cups
steps: Mash the chickpeas roughly.
Mix with yogurt, celery, onion, mustard, lemon and dill.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Quinoa and Black Beans
steps: Mix the quinoa, beans, corn, tomatoes and spices.
Fill the halved peppers and top with cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Cauliflower Steak with Chimichurri
steps: Slice the cauliflower into thick steaks and roast with half the oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Chop the parsley and mix with garlic, vinegar, remaining oil and oregano.
Spoon over the steaks.

name: Portobello Fajita Wraps
steps: Slice the mushrooms, peppers and onion and sauté in oil with the seasoning.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with vegetables and avocado and finish with lime.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Bowls
steps: Roast or warm the chickpeas.
Build bowls from quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and feta.
Dress with lemon and oil.

name: Lentil Bolognese over Zucchini Noodles
steps: Simmer the cooked lentils with the onion, carrot, garlic, marinara and seasoning for 20 minutes.
Warm the zucchini noodles briefly.
Serve topped with parmesan.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Wilt the spinach with garlic and mix with the ricotta, egg and parmesan.
Fill the caps.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Black Bean Burger Bowls with Avocado Crema
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg and spices and form four patties; pan-fry 5 minutes a side.
Blend the avocado, yogurt and lime into a crema.
Serve the patties over romaine and tomato with the crema.

name: Edamame and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
steps: Stir-fry the vegetables, garlic and ginger in a little sesame oil.
Add the edamame and soy sauce.
Serve over rice.

name: Tempeh Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Crumble the tempeh and brown in oil with the seasoning.
Toss the cabbage with lime and cilantro.
Fill warm tortillas with tempeh, slaw and avocado.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Pasta with White Beans
steps: Cook the pasta.
Simmer the garlic, tomatoes and beans, stir in the cream and basil.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Chili
steps: Soften the onion and garlic, add the spices.
Add the sweet potato, beans, tomatoes and broth and simmer 30 minutes.
Finish with lime.

name: Falafel Bowls with Tahini Sauce
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, parsley, onion, garlic, cumin and oat flour and shape patties.
Bake on an oiled tray at 400°F for 25 minutes.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and a little water.
Serve over quinoa with cucumber and tomato.

name: Vegetable Lo Mein with Tofu
steps: Boil the noodles.
Brown the tofu in oil, add the vegetables, garlic and ginger.
Toss with the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Caprese Stuffed Portobello Caps
steps: Brush the caps with oil and roast 8 minutes.
Fill with tomatoes, garlic and mozzarella.
Bake 10 minutes more and finish with basil and balsamic.

name: Quinoa Black Bean Salad Jars
steps: Mix the quinoa, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Dress with lime and oil, fold in cilantro and avocado.
Pack in jars.

name: Roasted Cauliflower and Chickpea Tacos
steps: Roast the cauliflower and chickpeas with oil and spices at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the roasted vegetables, avocado, lime and cilantro.

name: Garlic Roasted Green Beans with Almonds
steps: Toss the beans with oil and garlic and roast at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Top with almonds and lemon.

name: Lemon Parmesan Asparagus
steps: Roast the asparagus with oil and garlic at 425°F for 10 to 12 minutes.
Finish with lemon and parmesan.

name: Sauteed Spinach with Garlic
steps: Sauté the garlic in oil.
Wilt the spinach and finish with lemon and pepper flakes.

name: Zucchini Fritters with Greek Yogurt Dip
steps: Grate and squeeze the zucchini.
Mix with egg, almond flour, parmesan and salt and pan-fry small cakes in oil.
Stir the yogurt with dill for dipping.

name: Broccoli Slaw with Peanut Dressing
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, lime and ginger.
Toss with the slaw, shredded broccoli and carrot.

name: Mushroom Wild Rice Pilaf
steps: Sauté the onion and mushrooms in butter with thyme.
Add the cooked wild rice and broth and heat through.
Top with toasted pecans.

name: Quinoa Tabbouleh
steps: Chop the herbs and vegetables finely.
Toss with the quinoa, lemon and oil.

name: Cheddar Chive Cauliflower Biscuits
steps: Steam and squeeze the cauliflower rice dry.
Mix with the almond flour, cheddar, eggs, chives, baking powder and garlic powder.
Scoop eight biscuits and bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Spiced Roasted Carrots and Chickpeas
steps: Roast the carrots and chickpeas with oil and spices at 425°F for 30 minutes.
Serve with yogurt thinned with lemon.

name: Oat Flour Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana and whisk with eggs and milk.
Stir in the oat flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Cook small pancakes in butter, 2 minutes a side.

name: Almond Flour Pancakes with Berries
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and vanilla and stir in the almond flour and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in butter.
Serve with berries.

name: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oat flour, vanilla and cinnamon.
Cook in butter 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Serve with strawberries.

name: Pumpkin Oat Pancakes
steps: Whisk the pumpkin, eggs and milk.
Stir in the oat flour, spice and baking powder.
Cook in butter 2 minutes a side.

name: Protein Waffles from Oats and Eggs
steps: Blend the oats, eggs, yogurt, baking powder and vanilla.
Cook in a greased waffle iron.
Top with blueberries.

name: Blueberry Oat Breakfast Muffins
steps: Whisk the eggs, yogurt, vanilla and sugar.
Fold in the oat flour, baking powder and blueberries.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Zucchini Bread Oatmeal Bake
steps: Mix everything and pour into a greased dish.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Casserole
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and pepper.
Layer with the spinach and cheddar in a dish.
Pour over the beaten eggs and milk and bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: Ham and Cheese Egg Roll-Ups
steps: Cook thin omelets in butter.
Top each with ham and Swiss and roll.

name: Spinach Feta Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble the eggs with the spinach in oil.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, feta and tomato and roll.

name: Chilaquiles-Style Egg Skillet
steps: Crisp torn tortillas in oil.
Warm in the salsa, then top with fried eggs.
Finish with cotija, avocado and cilantro.

name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Boats
steps: Bake the halved sweet potatoes until tender and scoop a well.
Fill with sautéed sausage and spinach.
Crack an egg into each, top with cheddar and bake 12 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Breakfast Bowl with Nuts and Seeds
steps: Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with berries, almonds and seeds and dust with cinnamon.

name: Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, peanut butter, yogurt and chia in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and top with banana.

name: Savory Oatmeal with Egg and Spinach
steps: Simmer the oats in the broth with the spinach.
Top with a poached or fried egg, parmesan and pepper.

name: Breakfast Sausage Patties with Apple
steps: Mix the turkey with grated apple, sage, thyme and salt.
Shape eight small patties.
Pan-fry in oil 5 to 6 minutes a side.

name: Cheddar Broccoli Egg Cups
steps: Divide the chopped broccoli and cheddar among six muffin cups.
Pour in the eggs whisked with milk and pepper.
Bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Sheet Pan Sausage with Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Toss everything on a tray with oil, garlic and seasoning.
Roast at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: Sheet Pan Salmon with Brussels Sprouts
steps: Roast the halved sprouts with oil at 425°F for 10 minutes.
Add the salmon brushed with mustard and garlic and roast 12 minutes more.
Serve with lemon.

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp and Vegetable Bake
steps: Toss the vegetables with oil and Old Bay and roast at 425°F for 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp and roast 5 minutes more.
Finish with lemon.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Chili
steps: Combine everything except the lime in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours.
Shred the chicken and finish with lime.

name: Slow Cooker Pot Roast Chili with Beans
steps: Combine everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 7 hours and shred the beef.

name: Slow Cooker Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Mix the turkey with egg, parmesan, onion, garlic and seasoning and shape meatballs.
Cook in the marinara on low 4 hours.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs with Smoked Paprika
steps: Rub the chicken with oil and spices.
Air fry at 380°F for 20 minutes, turning once.
Serve with steamed green beans.

name: Air Fryer Salmon with Lemon and Dill
steps: Brush the salmon with oil and seasoning.
Air fry at 390°F for 8 to 10 minutes.
Serve with lemon, dill and roasted asparagus.

name: Air Fryer Cauliflower Wings
steps: Toss the florets with oil, almond flour and garlic powder.
Air fry at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Toss with hot sauce and serve with a yogurt dill dip.

name: Air Fryer Shrimp with Garlic and Lime
steps: Toss the shrimp with oil, garlic, lime and spices.
Air fry at 400°F for 6 to 8 minutes.

name: Air Fryer Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix everything and shape twenty meatballs.
Air fry at 380°F for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Air Fryer Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
steps: Toss the halved sprouts with oil and chopped bacon.
Air fry at 380°F for 12 to 15 minutes and finish with balsamic.

name: Roast Beef and Horseradish Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with yogurt mixed with mustard.
Layer sliced roast beef, lettuce and tomato and roll.

name: Turkey Avocado Ranch Wrap
steps: Stir the yogurt with the ranch seasoning.
Fill the tortillas with turkey, avocado, lettuce and tomato.
Roll and halve.

name: Grilled Chicken Pesto Panini
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Layer on the bread with pesto, mozzarella and tomato.
Press in a hot pan until golden on both sides.

name: Caprese Sandwich on Ezekiel Bread
steps: Toast the bread.
Layer mozzarella, tomato and basil and drizzle with oil and balsamic.

name: Hummus and Roasted Vegetable Sandwich
steps: Roast the sliced vegetables in oil at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Spread the bread with hummus and pile on the vegetables and arugula.

name: Egg and Avocado Breakfast Sandwich on English Muffin
steps: Toast the muffins and fry the eggs.
Layer avocado, spinach, tomato and egg.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocado
steps: Mix the tuna with celery, yogurt, mustard, lemon and chives.
Fill the halved avocados.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad with Yogurt Dressing
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Blend the yogurt, lemon, garlic, mustard, oil and anchovy into a dressing.
Toss with the romaine and top with chicken and parmesan.

name: Greek Chicken Salad with Tzatziki
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Arrange the vegetables, olives and feta.
Mix the yogurt, lemon and garlic into a tzatziki and spoon on top.

name: Asian Chicken Salad with Sesame Dressing
steps: Shred the chicken and combine with cabbage, carrot, edamame and green onion.
Whisk the vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, peanut butter and ginger and toss through.

name: Spinach Strawberry Salad with Pecans
steps: Toss the spinach with strawberries, onion and pecans.
Dress with balsamic and oil and top with goat cheese.

name: Kale Caesar with Chickpea Croutons
steps: Roast the chickpeas with a little oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Massage the kale with the yogurt, lemon, garlic, mustard and oil.
Top with parmesan and the chickpeas.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato and Black Bean Salad
steps: Toss the sweet potato with oil and cumin and roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Combine with beans, arugula and onion.
Dress with lime and cilantro.

name: Cucumber Dill Chicken Salad Cups
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with yogurt, dill, lemon and onion.
Spoon into thick cucumber cups.

name: Wedge Salad with Blue Cheese and Tomatoes
steps: Cut the lettuce into wedges.
Blend the blue cheese, yogurt and lemon into a dressing.
Top with tomatoes, onion and crisp bacon.

name: Marinated Mushroom and Artichoke Salad
steps: Toss everything with the vinegar, oil and seasoning.
Marinate 30 minutes.

name: Taco Salad with Lime Crema
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning.
Arrange the romaine, beans, tomato and avocado in bowls.
Add the beef and cheddar and top with yogurt stirred with lime.

name: Antipasto Skewers
steps: Thread the mozzarella, tomatoes, olives, artichokes and basil onto skewers.
Drizzle with balsamic and oil.

name: Buffalo Chicken Thigh Bites with Celery and Blue Cheese
steps: Toss the chicken with baking powder and garlic powder and bake at 425°F for 40 minutes.
Toss with melted butter and hot sauce.
Serve with celery and blue cheese.

name: Caprese Dip with Veggie Dippers
steps: Mix the cream cheese, mozzarella, chopped tomatoes, basil and garlic in a dish.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.
Serve with the vegetables.

name: Edamame with Sea Salt and Lime
steps: Boil the edamame 5 minutes.
Toss with lime and salt.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus with Crudités
steps: Blend the chickpeas, red pepper, tahini, lemon, garlic and oil until smooth.
Serve with the vegetables.

name: Stuffed Mini Peppers with Cream Cheese and Chives
steps: Halve and seed the mini peppers.
Mix the cream cheese with chives and garlic powder.
Fill and dust with everything seasoning.

name: Spicy Roasted Chickpea Crunch
steps: Dry the chickpeas well and toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 400°F for 25 to 30 minutes until crisp.

name: Cheddar and Apple Slices with Walnuts
steps: Slice the apple and cheddar.
Serve with the walnuts.

name: Cottage Cheese with Cherry Tomatoes and Everything Seasoning
steps: Top the cottage cheese with halved tomatoes.
Finish with oil and everything seasoning.

name: Creamy Cauliflower and Leek Soup
steps: Soften the leek and garlic in oil.
Add the cauliflower and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with the milk and nutmeg.

name: Lentil and Spinach Soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth and cumin and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and lemon.

name: Butternut Squash Soup with Sage
steps: Roast the squash at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Soften the onion in oil, add the squash, broth and sage and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend with the cream.

name: Chicken Zucchini Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken and vegetables in the broth 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the zucchini noodles and heat 2 minutes.

name: Miso Mushroom Soup with Tofu
steps: Simmer the mushrooms and ginger in the broth 8 minutes.
Add the tofu and spinach.
Whisk in the miso off the heat and finish with green onion.

name: Tomato Basil Soup with White Beans
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend and finish with basil.

name: Turkey Vegetable Soup with Kale
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion.
Add the vegetables, tomatoes, broth and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the kale for the last 5.
